Description by creator:
"""
Adam Savage meets The General, the biggest character in LAIKA Studios' Wildwood, and the most advanced stop-motion puppet they've ever created. This golden eagle took years of development to create, and its complex armature is as breathtakingly beautiful as it is elegantly engineered. Senior armaturist Jeanne McIvor walks Adam through its fabrication and the features that allowed animators to control every muscle and feather on this majestic bird. 

Wildwood is in theaters now and tickets are av
"""

- "In a time of war, AI, greed and bad workmanship this company and their work is such a breath of fresh air. This is people at their best and shows how insane things we can achive if we work together and do our best. GO SEE THE DAMN MOVIE so this will not be the end of this." (934 likes)
- "This is how we protect human creativity. The story, the behind the scenes. The work that went into this is astonishing, I cant wait to see the movie!. Great video Tested!" (434 likes)
- "I'm blown away, I'm a biologist and avid birder and this armature can almost be used to teach bird skeletal anatomy. This piece of engineering and ART ought to be in a museum after. This will be an epic film" (427 likes)
- "I so so appreciate how much coverage of Wildwood BTS we have been getting from Adam/Tested and Laika. Such awesome conversations and wonderful insight to the creative processes of these amazing artists. Hats off tho everyone at Laika , and thank you all for STILL continuing to pursue this visual art form despite the various reasons to call it quits. Incredible work." (407 likes)
- "The more detailed of Adam's questions get I can hear the increase of enthusiasm in her voice. Wonderful video." (266 likes)
- "This is so crazy. I just saw Wildwood and it was by far the best movie I've seen in well over a decade. It was phenomenal" (188 likes)
- "This is not just art. It’s science and art. The engineering, the physics the mathematics the art. It’s everything" (142 likes)
